more_info.overview: E470b covers magnesium salts of fatty acids that occur in edible fats and oils. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. Magnesium salts are prepared from fatty acids obtained from edible fats or oils. The specification does not identify a single biological source for those fats. The specified material is supplied as white powder or flakes. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit juices as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable juices; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: Magnesium salts are prepared from fatty acids obtained from edible fats or oils. The specification does not identify a single biological source for those fats.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
The reviewed evidence did not indicate mutagenic or cancer effects.
